text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well! That was a fun race. Yes, indeed...
I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If the hands of time had moved
differently, would
Maruzen have lost at
the Arima?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What are you talking about?!
Maruzen
wasn't the one who lost today! I
was!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm not going to give up just
because of
this! I'll beat you next time, I
swear!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That means we'll be at two-nothing after
next
year's Arima!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, what a mess this has become.
First you
entered the Japan Cup, and
now even C.B. has
run in the Arima...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
After all the care and thought I put into
advising you, too. You can lead an
Umamusume to water,
but you can't
make her drink, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but it was so much fun! What's the
harm in
having some fun, hm?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Come on, stop looking so severe.
Cheer up
and get swept up in the
festivities around you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You can't hide it from me... You were
excited
during the race, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
See, I told you so! Not only is Chiyo
determined,
but she's fun to watch!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But this is just the beginning for her.
She'll
become even more spectacular
yet!
